clips.title: The story
paras: Darkshire Town Hall anchors a town besieged by darkness and undead. Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke and his council govern from its dim halls.

Darkshire Town Hall stands just west of the main square, where the town's leaders meet to govern an increasingly isolated territory. Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke struggles to keep order and protect the people while Stormwind sends little military aid. Clerk Daltry and other officials track town records and the travelers who brave Duskwood's dangerous roads. With danger all around, keeping those ledgers current is a grim task.
